verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs say DML statements can delete data from tables, which covers user-controlled deletion. Nothing in the pack documents retention controls such as table or dataset expiration, retention windows, or time-travel retention configuration; the time-travel item only describes historical access. missing for 10: documented retention/expiration policy controls, configurable time-travel/fail-safe retention, deletion guarantees (e.g., purge of backups), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Data Manipulation Language (DML) statements enable you to update, insert, and delete data from your BigQuery tables.
